name: pc-portfolio
description: Root project — satu 'npm install' dan satu 'npm run dev' untuk client + server sekaligus.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev:server: node scripts/check-structure.mjs && npm --prefix server run dev
scripts.dev:client: node scripts/check-structure.mjs && npm --prefix client run dev
scripts.seed:admin: node scripts/check-structure.mjs && npm --prefix server run seed:admin
scripts.build: node scripts/check-structure.mjs && npm --prefix client run build
